text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Mejiro Bright's all-important debut race has come. And while most racers would arrive at the track with time to spare…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Good morning to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright's appearance is as unhurried as ever. And not only that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, this is Maki. Given that today is such an important race, I thought it best to bring her along to watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My other little one, Kyu, is back at home. I expect she's probably napping at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even as our leisurely chat continues, race time draws closer and closer. And then…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone. Let's all have a terrific race today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huhhh?! You brought a doll into the paddock…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: What are you doing? What event do you think this is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why, it's the day of our ever-so-joyous debut. And as such…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I thought I might approach it calmly. Now, let's all of us have a leisurely time today, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah… Good point… When she puts it like that, it's kinda hard to argue…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I guess we were all pretty on edge, huh? Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: H-hey, look! All the fire in the runners' faces is dying down…

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, what the heck are they talking about? Their expressions are getting all soft and relaxed…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Mejiro Bright's relaxed vibe is infectious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, after a short waiting period…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee. Ah, the joyous race is just about to begin. And seeing as it is a race…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm staying perfectly calm… Niiice and calm… I shall race at my own pace, as always…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's talking to her doll as if she's trying to soothe it, but her voice… It's very slightly trembling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This isn't Mejiro Bright fooling around—this is her trying to stay as calm as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is something the matter?
choice_data_list: No, it's fine. But be sure to take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …I shall. Thank you very much. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if relieved, the young Mejiro lady smiles warmly.
